equity.level_reason: Age (adults) defines the population and sex appears only in a generalizability limitation; occupation is the setting, not social position. No SPD group results.

notes: Headline is a single-group cumulative percentage by day; comparison framework set from the three-level vaccination-status case proportions and periods, since the headline does not decide it. The 7-day median among all 173 ignores censoring of the 27 never negative within 10 days; no Kaplan-Meier was used. The design is inferred: the report evaluates a program strategy without stated targets.
view_issues: The Discussion uses 'significantly improved' colloquially for symptoms; there are no tests, CIs or p-values. 'NFL-NFPLA' is a typo. Median time to first negative among all 173 includes persons without a negative result.
